core_problem: Addressing inefficiencies, logic inconsistencies, and communication topology issues in LLM-based multi-agent collaboration systems for software engineering.
methodology_summary: MetaGPT introduces standard operating procedures (SOPs) into multi-agent collaboration frameworks based on LLMs, enabling structured role-playing and directional information sharing among agents.
empirical_results: MetaGPT achieves a 100% task completion rate on experimental evaluations and generates more coherent code, outperforming baseline models on code generation benchmarks.
explicit_limitations: Each software project is executed independently, lacking long-term active teamwork learning and cross-project knowledge retention.
